card.name: Words just before 'effective' or 'effectiveness'
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word endings right before the model expects 'effective', 'effectiveness' or 'ineffective'. Seen in text about drugs losing effect, such as charcoal, contraceptives or reduced exposure.

modes.label: Linking word before effectiveness
modes.description: A word like 'and', 'their' or 'be' that is followed by effective or effectiveness.
modes.example: significantly decrease the retention<< and>> the effectiveness of oral activated charcoal.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says whether a treatment is effective or ineffective.
